xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfAuditQualificationExp: HLFL, a material subsidiary has engaged an independent agency to conduct a comprehensive review of certain systems and processes. HLFL will evaluate and take appropriate action as may be deemed necessary, as more fully described in Note 8 to the Statement. Pending conclusion of the aforesaid comprehensive review, we were unable to determine whether any adjustments were necessary to the Statement, which includes HLFL’s Special Purpose Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results that reflect total assets of Rs. 70,403.39 crores and net assets of Rs. 9,263.85 crores as at September 30, 2026, total revenue of Rs. 2,229.70 crores and Rs. 4,444.27 crores, total net profit after tax of Rs. 174.54 crores and Rs. 364.29 crores, and total comprehensive income of Rs. (1,311.97) crores and Rs. (1,244.97) crores for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, respectively and cash flows (net) of Rs. (1,630.40) crores for the period from April 01, 2026 to September 30, 2026.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AuditQualificationsWhereTheImp: HLFL a subsidiary of the company, is in the process of reconciling certain differences in loan balances between different underlying sub-systems, the Impact of which on its financial results, if any, is currently not ascertainable. Consequently, the consolidated financial results have been prepared without recognizing any possible impact of such differences. HLFL has engaged an independent systems expert to conduct a comprehensive review of the related systems and processes. Upon completion of the said review, HLFL shall evaluate and take appropriate action as deemed necessary, in accordance with the applicable accounting and regulatory requirements. In view of the above, the statutory auditors of HLFL have expressed their inability to form a conclusion on financial results of HLFL and consequently, the statutory auditors of the Company have also disclaimed their conclusion on the consolidated financial results. In the opinion of the management, these differences are not likely to be significant enough to adversely impact the financial health of HLFL, including its ability to service debt obligations.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ReasonsIfManagementIsUnableToE: In the opinion of the management, these differences are not likely to be significant enough to adversely impact the financial health of HLFL, including its ability to service debt obligations.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AuditorsCommentsOnManagementsE: Due to the significance of the matter described in the ‘Basis for Disclaimer of conclusion’ , we were unable to obtain sufficient appropriate evidence to form a conclusion on the Statement. Accordingly, we do not express a conclusion on the Statement.
